categories.title: Guide
categories.blurb: How Essence & Earth works, from your first essence to a farm of diamonds.

entries.name: Getting started
entries.summary: Find Terra Essence, upgrade it, and plant your first resource crop.

blocks.html: Essence & Earth lets you grow resources. Every crop starts as essence: you combine essence with the resource you want, plant the seeds, and harvest essence that crafts back into that resource.
Mine Essence Ore underground, between y −48 and 48 in newly explored chunks. Terra Essence also drops now and then from grass and ripe vanilla crops, so you can start in an old world.

items.name: Wheat Crops
items.sub: Ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot: 5% chance

blocks.html: Four essence of one tier craft one of the next: Terra → Aqua → Ignis → Aether → Astra. Each crop needs the essence of its tier.
Surround wheat seeds with four tier essence and four of the resource. Plant the seeds on essence farmland and wait. Bone meal can help: each use has a 25% chance to advance a stage.
A ripe crop drops 1–2 of its essence and its seed back. Eight essence in a ring craft the resource.

entries.name: Growing crops
entries.summary: Planting, growth stages, bone meal and harvesting.

facts: 4 stages, about 50% chance per random tick
25% chance to advance one stage per use
1–2 essence, 1 seed, 5% chance of a second seed

blocks.html: Seeds won't plant on vanilla farmland. Every crop needs essence farmland, of any tier, so each plot in your garden has to be crafted. It never dries out and can't be trampled.
Ripe crops on essence farmland can drop an extra essence. The higher the farmland's tier, the better the chance.
Stack up to 4 growth accelerators directly under the farmland to make the crop above grow faster. Each one adds growth rolls, tiers can be mixed, and a gap ends the stack.

entries.summary: Up to ×1.8 crop speed with a full stack.

facts: Directly under essence farmland, up to 4 deep, with no gaps
